Author: kuchris
Name: OCBFR
Description:
OCBFR 是新月島尋寶自動化插件，提供寶箱掃描、內外環尋寶、錢幣兌換、退本重入及戰利品記錄。支援繁體中文／English 介面。需要 Daily Routines、vnavmesh 與 BOCCHI。

OCBFR automates Occult Crescent coffer scanning, treasure routes, currency purchases and re-entry, with loot tracking and a Traditional Chinese / English interface. Requires Daily Routines, vnavmesh and BOCCHI.
Punchline: 新月島尋寶自動化與戰利品記錄 / Occult Crescent treasure automation and loot tracking.
Changelog: Global 2.3.0.17：小水晶傳送失敗最多嘗試三次，仍失敗或導航超時則退島重入；連續三十分鐘沒有移動、換階段或開箱時自動恢復，戰鬥及載入期間不觸發。Retries failed shard teleports up to three attempts, then leaves and re-enters. Navigation timeouts and 30 minutes without movement, phase changes or coffer openings also trigger recovery; combat and loading are excluded.
